rungsNotMeasured.reason: MEASURED cost: one n=960 run-to-floor solve is 138 s wall with both operators resident and 33 s with only f64 (the 4.2x gap independently reproduces scratch-7b/h23.ts:190-196’s "a second resident HierarchicalA slows applyA 6x"). The per-doubling cost ratio MEASURED between n=480 and n=960 is 3.0x against the 1.66x the apply-count budget predicted, because the budget omitted the Arnoldi orthogonalisation: full GMRES at maxit=600 costs O(iters^2 * dim) = 600^2 * 2880 = 1.04e9 at n=960, roughly 8x the near-field apply work, and it is INDEPENDENT of the apply count. n=1920 therefore costs ~69 min of foreground time for a rung whose value the ladder already determines.
rungsNotMeasured.whyItCostsTheGateNothing: the gated floor is FLAT-to-FALLING over the five measured rungs (0.4118 -> 0.3112 u_f32, exponent -0.103), the margin GROWS with n (121.4x -> 160.6x), and [A26] already published this quantity at n=1920. H3 covers n=1920 in its own currency.

limitations: H2 certifies BACKWARD error, not solution or direction quality (spec §7.3:1557). A GREEN H2 says the residual is as small as the precision allows, not that x̃ is close to x*.

eta_exact and eta_bct share ONE schedule and ONE exactApplyA by construction (gmres.ts:344-382; probeAt at :688-716 computes both on every probe), so the chi=0 probe cost cannot be reduced without changing an exported interface. The chi=0 share of one solve is 79 % at n=960 and 89 % at n=1920 (MEASURED, scratch-11/budget.json).

INVALID clause 3 (exact-equals-bct) is scoped by the HARNESS, not by etaViolations: it is an inversion only where nFar > 0. nFar is MEASURED > 0 at every gated cell (1186 at n=960), so no gated row is exempt.

CENSORED BY DESIGN at n >= 240: every solve exhausts maxit=600 and stops with `maxit`, so `censored` is true and the gated floor is a MINIMUM OVER A CENSORED TRAJECTORY, not a converged limit. §7.3:1401 pins maxit precisely so the floors transfer literally, and gmres.ts records that under run-to-floor censoring "is expected true and is not an INVALID trigger" — but it is published per row (`censoredAny`) because a reader who does not know it would read the floor as a limit.

thetaSaturation.why: MEASURED (scratch-11/kocheck.ts, n=240): nFar is pinned at 274 and nearPairs at 7128 for EVERY theta >= 4, because raising theta converts would-be-admissible blocks into ADJACENCY-VETOED near blocks (adjacencyVetoed 50 -> 196) rather than far ones. delta_compress saturates at 1.568e-2 (1.7x the theta=0.5 value) and goes no further. The adjacency certificate is the floor on the operator accuracy, so no theta can over-compress this operator.

knockOut.spreadFinding: CONJUNCT 1 IS A WEAK GATE. Across operators spanning the exact dense A, theta=0.5, theta=4 and epsilon drift 1e-10 -> 1e-2, R_E spans only 0.9987-1.0034 (MEASURED, scratch-11/koc.ts): the line search accepts tau=1 on every step and R_E is near 1 for any roughly-downhill direction. The bar at 0.95 is reached only by an exponent drift of a whole 1.5, and alpha=2 lands at 0.9652 — 0.0152 from RED.
